name: Gianni Infantino
quote: We have to unite. We have to bring people together. [May 1, 2026 — FIFA Congress, Vancouver: Infantino confirmed Iran WILL play all three group-stage matches on US soil, directly overriding Iran Sports Minister's 'under no circumstances' statement. Iran's federation president was absent — denied entry to Canada the previous day due to alleged IRGC ties.] Earlier: Iran is coming for sure. [CNBC Invest in America Forum, April 2026.] The FIFA Council in Vancouver approved the record $871M total financial contribution for 2026 on April 29. FIFA's VIP motorcade request for Infantino was denied by Vancouver Police, which ruled he does not qualify as an Internationally Protected Person. [Aug 5-10, 2026 — FIFA leadership crisis: Infantino apologized for 'mistakes' in the handling of the abandoned World Cup stake-sale plan at a Rabat crisis meeting, retaining internal backing, but faced escalating calls to resign from Norway's Lise Klaveness and a joint open letter from UEFA, CONCACAF, and the AFC accusing him of 'deception' and a 'fundamental breach of trust.' FIFA called it a 'concerted and ongoing effort' to undermine him ahead of the March 18, 2027 presidential election in Rabat.] [Aug 13-18, 2026 UPDATE: The federation revolt widened — Ireland, New Zealand (first Oceania break), Scotland, and Israel all withdrew earlier endorsements, while six Arab federations publicly reaffirmed support on Aug 13. Infantino fired FIFA COO Kevin Lamour on Aug 17 after Lamour publicly accused him of misleading staff over the stake-sale plan. President Trump continued to publicly back Infantino, warning federations would be making a 'terrible mistake' to replace him.] [Aug 22-24, 2026 UPDATE: Infantino defied a CONCACAF request from Victor Montagliani and attended a Caribbean Football Union youth event in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic (Aug 22), later saying he received 'a very, very warm welcome.' All six Nordic federations declared they had 'lost confidence' in him (Aug 23), demanding binding guarantees against private ownership of FIFA competitions and an independent investigation. UEFA's Čeferin ruled out challenging him directly but said Infantino would either step down or 'have a candidate against him' ahead of the March 2027 vote (Aug 24).] [Aug 26-27, 2026 UPDATE: Italy's FIGC withdrew support for his re-election (Aug 26). Court filings the next day revealed UEFA is preparing a criminal complaint against Infantino in Switzerland for 'criminal mismanagement' over the abandoned stake-sale plan, seeking discovery from two Florida-based FIFA entities (Aug 27).]

name: Donald Trump
role: President of the United States (Host Nation)
quote: The Iran National Soccer Team is welcome to The World Cup, but I really don't believe it is appropriate that they be there, for their own life and safety.

name: Claudia Sheinbaum
quote: Mexico has no issue hosting the Iranian national team. [May 25, 2026 — Sheinbaum confirmed Mexico will host Iran's national team in Tijuana during the World Cup after the US failed to issue visas to any Iranian delegation member. Iran will use Tijuana as their base camp and commute across the border for group-stage matches at SoFi Stadium (Inglewood) and Lumen Field (Seattle). Mexico City also announced new health protocols for DR Congo's delegation in response to the Ebola outbreak. 15 days to kickoff.]

name: Mark Carney
quote: It is the number one sport for Canadian boys and girls. Two-thirds of the country watched the last World Cup and we are partnered with the United States and Mexico, welcoming the world.

name: Victor Montagliani
quote: The 2026 World Cup in North America will be the most transformational event in the history of our confederation. We are ready to show the world what this region can do. [Aug 10, 2026 — Montagliani co-signed a joint open letter with UEFA and the AFC accusing FIFA president Infantino of 'deception' and a 'fundamental breach of trust' over the abandoned World Cup stake-sale plan, calling for an independent review.] [Aug 21-22, 2026 UPDATE: Montagliani emailed Infantino asking him 'in the name of football' to skip a Caribbean Football Union youth event in Punta Cana, warning his presence amid the governance crisis would overshadow the technical competition. Infantino attended anyway on Aug 22, a visit read by observers as an attempt to lobby Caribbean federations for re-election votes and split the Concacaf bloc. UEFA's Čeferin named Montagliani (Aug 24) as one of the officials who could emerge as a challenger to Infantino in the March 2027 election.]

name: Cindy Parlow Cone
quote: The World Cup coming to the United States is a once-in-a-generation opportunity to grow the game across our country. Our federation has never been better prepared.

name: Mauricio Pochettino
quote: We are ready. The boys showed exactly what they can do — and what they can do is compete with anyone in this tournament. [June 1, 2026 — following USMNT's 3-2 win over Senegal on May 31 at Bank of America Stadium, Charlotte. Sergiño Dest 7', Christian Pulisic 20' (ends five-month goal drought), Folaron Balogun 63' winner (halftime sub); Sadio Mané scored twice for Senegal. Chris Richards did not feature (ankle management). Pulisic captains; Reyna and Zendejas included. Group D: Paraguay (June 12, SoFi LA), Kosovo (June 16, AT&T Dallas), Australia (June 21, NRG Houston). 10 days to kickoff.]

name: Jesús Gutiérrez
quote: We are committed to delivering a world-class experience for all fans. Mexico has hosted the World Cup twice and we know what it takes to do it right.

name: Nick Bontis
quote: This World Cup will be a transformational moment for football in Canada, inspiring the next generation of players and proving that Canada belongs on the world stage.

name: Jamil Dakwar
role: ACLU Human Rights Director (Civil Liberties Advocate)
quote: With less than 100 days until kick-off, the escalating attacks on immigrants in the United States, lack of clear safeguards at stadiums against abusive federal immigration enforcement, and FIFA's cancellation of anti-discrimination messaging signal a tournament heading in the wrong direction.

name: Lionel Messi
role: Argentina Captain / Inter Miami CF Forward (World Cup Finalist)
quote: I hope I can be there. I've said before that I'd love to be there. At worst, I'll be there watching it live, but it will be special. The World Cup is special for everyone — especially for us, because we live it in a completely different way. [June 7, 2026 UPDATE: Messi sat out Argentina vs Honduras pre-tournament friendly — training individually in Kansas City on precautionary hamstring management ('muscular overload' since late May). Scaloni confirms Messi expected fit for June 16 Group J opener vs Algeria (Arrowhead Stadium, Kansas City). Status doubtful for final friendly vs Iceland June 9. Squad also losing Balerdi (soleus, ruled out June 6) — Senesi leading replacement candidate. Emiliano Martínez managing fractured finger. Record-equalling 6th World Cup. 4 days to kickoff.] [July 15, 2026 UPDATE: Messi factored heavily in Argentina's 2-1 semifinal comeback win over England in Atlanta, sending Argentina to the World Cup Final for the first time since 2022 — a historic first-ever final meeting with Spain, set for July 19 at MetLife Stadium. Messi scored his 7th goal of the tournament in the Round of 32 win over Cabo Verde.]

name: Kylian Mbappé
role: France Captain / Real Madrid Forward (Eliminated, Semifinal)
quote: France comes with the ambition to win. We have a complete squad, experienced players, and the hunger to bring the trophy back to Paris. [May 14, 2026 UPDATE: Mbappé CONFIRMED in Deschamps' final 26-man France squad despite hamstring management by Real Madrid's medical staff — he missed El Clásico (May 10) but is expected fit for the tournament. France open Group I vs Iraq June 15. 27 days to kickoff.] [July 14, 2026 UPDATE: Mbappe exited France's 2-0 quarterfinal win over Morocco (July 9) with what he called a "minor ankle injury," saying he was "completely fine" afterward. France was eliminated 0-2 by Spain in the July 14 semifinal in Dallas; France plays England in the third-place playoff July 18 in Miami.]

name: Lionel Scaloni
quote: Messi will take this time calmly before making a final decision. He always tells me that he would like me to be there in any role. We have a relationship of great trust and we can talk about everything. [May 30, 2026 — Scaloni OFFICIALLY named Argentina's 26-man World Cup squad, confirming Messi despite May 24 hamstring scare. 'The injury is not that bad.' 17 returners from 2022 World Cup squad. Nico Paz included as breakthrough. Dybala, Garnacho, Mastantuono, Soule cut. Group J: Algeria (June 16), Austria, Jordan — Arrowhead Stadium, Kansas City. 11 days to kickoff.]

name: Thomas Tuchel
role: England Head Coach (Eliminated, Semifinal — Plays 3rd-Place Playoff July 18)
quote: We have 26 one-hundred per cent committed players… we don't want to be shy about it — the goal is to try and win it. [May 22, 2026 SQUAD ANNOUNCED at Wembley: Harry Kane captains for a third World Cup (equalling Billy Wright's record). Full squad: GK: D. Henderson, Pickford, Trafford. DEF: Burn, Guéhi, R. James, Konsa, Livramento, O'Reilly, Quansah, Spence, Stones. MID: E. Anderson, Bellingham, Eze, Henderson, Mainoo, Rice, M. Rogers. FWD: Gordon, Kane, Madueke, Rashford, Saka, Ivan Toney, Watkins. Notable omissions: Cole Palmer, Phil Foden, Trent Alexander-Arnold, Harry Maguire (said he was 'shocked and gutted'). Toney recalled as surprise. Jordan Henderson: record-tying 4th World Cup (=Charlton). 9 debutants. Group L: Croatia, Ghana, Panama. 20 days to kickoff.] [July 15, 2026 UPDATE: England lost 1-2 to Argentina in the World Cup semifinal in Atlanta despite taking an early lead; England face France in the third-place playoff, July 18 in Miami.]

name: Didier Deschamps
role: France Head Coach (Eliminated, Semifinal — Final Tournament Ends July 18)
quote: We prepare meticulously for every tournament. France's goal is always the same: to win. [May 14, 2026 UPDATE: Deschamps announced his final 26-man France squad in Paris — confirmed as his last tournament as Les Bleus head coach after a tenure beginning in 2012 that delivered the 2018 World Cup. Kylian Mbappé confirmed as captain despite hamstring management. Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) and Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) excluded. Hugo Ekitike (Achilles) out. Rayan Cherki, Desire Doue, Michael Olise, Jean-Philippe Mateta among the fresh faces. France open Group I vs Iraq June 15. 27 days to kickoff.] [July 14, 2026 UPDATE: France was eliminated 0-2 by Spain in the semifinal in Dallas. Deschamps' final tournament in charge of France ends with the third-place playoff vs England, July 18 in Miami.]

name: Mehdi Taj
quote: Our host is FIFA, not Mr. Trump or America. [June 7, 2026 UPDATE: Iran squad has arrived in Tijuana, Mexico after departing Antalya June 6. Players received US visas (White House confirmed June 6) — forfeiture averted. However, Iran's federation accused the US of 'vindictive behavior' after 14 officials including secretary-general Hedayat Mombeini and VP Mehdi Mohammad Nabi were denied visas. June 5: Taj submitted passports to US Embassy in Ankara, warned FIFA that denial meant 'reconsideration of participation.' Visas issued for players/athletes; IRGC-linked staff excluded per Rubio. Squad now at Centro Xoloitzcuintle base camp, Tijuana. Group G: SoFi LA (June 15 vs NZ, June 21 vs Belgium), Lumen Seattle (June 26 vs Egypt). 4 days to kickoff.]

name: Ahmad Donyamali
role: Iran Minister of Sport and Youth
quote: Under no circumstances can [Iran] participate in this World Cup. [April 30, 2026 — issued hours after Iran's federation president Mehdi Taj was denied entry to Canada at Toronto Pearson Airport and barred from the FIFA Congress. Iran's warm-up friendlies were simultaneously cancelled. On May 1, FIFA President Infantino overrode this position at the Vancouver Congress, confirming Iran's participation under FIFA's governance framework — which recognizes football federations, not government ministries. The June 1 squad submission deadline is the next hard decision point for whether Iran's government will allow the federation to comply with FIFA's confirmation.]

name: Timothy Weah
quote: The ticket prices are too expensive. Lots of real fans will miss matches. Football should still be enjoyed by everyone.

name: Christian Pulisic
quote: I think you could say so — this is the strongest squad I've been part of. Looking at the guys playing at the highest levels and doing extremely well at their clubs, you have a really, really strong squad and depth as well. Multiple guys that can play in every position. The team's in a good place. People should be excited and hopefully ready to cheer us on. [April 21, 2026, Reuters]

name: Marco Rubio
quote: Nothing from the US has told them they can't come. The problem with Iran would be not their athletes. It would be some of the other people they would want to bring with them, some of whom have ties to the IRGC. They can't bring a bunch of IRGC terrorists into our country and pretend that they are journalists and athletic trainers. [April 24, 2026, on Iran's World Cup participation]

name: Hajime Moriyasu
quote: It's a huge blow. [May 15, 2026 — on Kaoru Mitoma's omission from Japan's final 26-man World Cup squad due to a hamstring injury. Moriyasu named his squad in Tokyo on May 15. Notable: Takehiro Tomiyasu returns after a nearly two-year international absence; Yuto Nagatomo selected for a fifth World Cup. Japan in Group F: vs Netherlands (June 14, Arlington), Tunisia (June 21, Guadalajara), Sweden (June 25, Arlington). 27 days to kickoff.]

name: Son Heung-min
role: South Korea Captain / Tottenham Hotspur Forward (Confirmed in 26-Man Squad — May 16)
quote: Playing in the World Cup for my country is always a great privilege and responsibility. We will give everything for the people of Korea. [May 16, 2026 — confirmed as captain of South Korea's 26-man World Cup squad announced by coach Hong Myung-bo in Seoul. Squad also features Kim Min-jae (Bayern Munich), Lee Kang-in (PSG), and Jens Castrop — first dual German-Korean heritage player in Taeguk Warriors history. 26 days to kickoff.]

name: Hong Myung-bo
quote: Our goal is to reach the round of 16 as a minimum. We have quality players in Europe's top leagues. [May 16, 2026 — announced South Korea's 26-man World Cup roster in Seoul. Son Heung-min captains; Jens Castrop becomes the first German-Korean dual-heritage player named to South Korea — a historic milestone. Kim Min-jae (Bayern Munich) and Lee Kang-in (PSG) included. Hwang In-beom selected despite ankle injury. 26 days to kickoff.]

name: Cristiano Ronaldo
role: Portugal Captain / Al Nassr Forward (Record Sixth World Cup — History's First Six-Time Participant)
quote: I never stop believing. Age is just a number. This will be the most special World Cup of my life. [May 19, 2026 — confirmed by coach Roberto Martinez in Portugal's 26-man World Cup squad; Ronaldo (41) becomes the first player in history to compete at six FIFA World Cups. Portugal in Group K: vs DR Congo (June 18), Colombia (June 22), Uzbekistan (June 27). The squad includes a 27th honorary place for the late Diogo Jota. 23 days to kickoff.]

name: Roberto Martínez
quote: Ronaldo is in the squad. He showed the quality and experience we need. He is part of our history and will be part of this World Cup chapter. The 27th honorary place for Diogo shows what this squad means — as a family. [May 19, 2026 — Martínez announced Portugal's 26-man World Cup squad in Lisbon, confirming Ronaldo for a record sixth World Cup and adding a symbolic honorary 27th spot for the late Diogo Jota. Group K: DR Congo (June 18), Colombia (June 22), Uzbekistan (June 27). 23 days to kickoff.]

name: Steve Clarke
role: Scotland Head Coach (First World Cup Since 1998 — 28-Year Return)
quote: This squad represents everything Scottish football has worked for. We've earned this — Scotland are back on the world stage and we go there to compete. [May 19, 2026 — Clarke named Scotland's 26-man World Cup squad, the nation's first since France 1998. Captain Andy Robertson (92 caps, Liverpool) leads alongside Scott McTominay (Napoli), John McGinn (Aston Villa), and Ché Adams (Torino). Group C: vs Haiti (June 14, Foxborough), Morocco (June 20), Brazil (June 25). 23 days to kickoff.]

name: Julian Nagelsmann
quote: Manuel Neuer is one of the greatest goalkeepers of all time. He earned his place — I needed to know he was ready and he is. [May 21, 2026 — Nagelsmann announced Germany's 26-man World Cup squad, with the defining story being Manuel Neuer's (40) return from international retirement as first-choice goalkeeper. Joshua Kimmich captains; Jamal Musiala, Florian Wirtz lead the attack; Rüdiger, Tah, Anton, Thiaw in defence. Notable omissions: Gnabry (injury), Füllkrug, Adeyemi. Germany in Group E: Curaçao (June 14, Houston), Ivory Coast (June 20, Toronto), Ecuador (June 25, MetLife NJ). 21 days to kickoff.] [June 29, 2026 UPDATE: Germany was eliminated in the Round of 32, losing 4-3 on penalties to Paraguay after a 1-1 draw. Nagelsmann called a VAR-disallowed extra-time goal for Jonathan Tah "a joke."]

name: Ronald Koeman
quote: Memphis Depay is one of our best players — when he is fit and motivated, he changes games. [May 27, 2026 — Koeman announced Netherlands' 26-man World Cup squad, with Memphis Depay returning from injury as headline news. Virgil van Dijk captains; Frenkie de Jong and Jurrien Timber included. Xavi Simons (ACL) and Jeremie Frimpong are the notable absences. GK: Bart Verbruggen (Brighton, starter), Flekken, Roefs. Netherlands in Group A: vs Senegal (June 12, Houston), Brazil (June 17, Dallas), Serbia (June 22, Pasadena). 15 days to kickoff.]

name: Carlo Ancelotti
quote: Neymar is in the squad. He showed in the last weeks his condition has improved — we believe in him. [June 7, 2026 UPDATE: Ancelotti confirmed Neymar's MRI is scheduled for Monday June 8 — Neymar trained separately in New Jersey while the squad beat Egypt 2-1 in their final warm-up in Cleveland. Neymar is doubtful for Brazil's June 13 Group D opener vs Morocco. FIFA rules allow squad replacement up to 24 hours before first match. Originally confirmed at Museum of Tomorrow in Rio (May 18) despite Santos accidentally substituting him at halftime May 17. Key squad: Vinicius Junior, Endrick (Real Madrid), Matheus Cunha (Man City), Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle), Gabriel Magalhaes (Arsenal). Absences: Rodrygo (ACL), Eder Militão (hamstring), Estevao (hamstring). 4 days to kickoff.]

name: Neymar Jr.
role: Brazil Forward / Santos FC (Grade 2 Calf Strain — Doubtful for June 13 Opener)
quote: I want to be there — I have always dreamed of winning the World Cup for Brazil. [June 7, 2026 UPDATE: Neymar is DOUBTFUL for Brazil's June 13 Group D opener vs Morocco after a Grade 2 calf strain suffered on May 17 vs Coritiba. He trained separately at Brazil's New Jersey base while the squad beat Egypt 2-1 in Cleveland on June 7. An MRI is scheduled for Monday June 8. Brazil can replace him up to 24 hours before their first match under FIFA medical exception rules; no replacement decision yet from Ancelotti. Jersey #10 assigned. Group D: Morocco (June 13, Inglewood), Cameroon (June 18), Serbia (June 23). Absence would be a major blow to Brazil's hopes.]

name: Luis de la Fuente
quote: [July 14, 2026: Spain reached the World Cup final for the first time since winning the title in 2010, beating France 2-0 in Dallas behind goals from Mikel Oyarzabal and Pedro Porro. Spain has conceded just one goal across seven matches this tournament. Spain faces Argentina in the final, July 19 at MetLife Stadium — the first-ever World Cup final meeting between the two nations.]

name: Aleksander Čeferin
quote: [Aug 10, 2026] When trust is broken through deception, when an individual places himself above the collective that entrusted him with authority, that duty has been abandoned. Čeferin co-signed UEFA, CONCACAF, and the AFC's joint open letter accusing FIFA president Gianni Infantino of a 'fundamental breach of trust' over the abandoned World Cup stake-sale plan, and maintained UEFA's threatened boycott of FIFA competitions, including September 2026's Under-20 Women's World Cup. [Aug 2026 UPDATE: UEFA maintained its boycott position even after Infantino's climbdown and apology, saying it retains no confidence in his leadership; European football executives have discussed encouraging PSG president Nasser Al-Khelaifi to challenge Infantino for the FIFA presidency, though Al-Khelaifi has publicly denied interest, saying he is 'very, very happy' leading PSG.] [Aug 24, 2026 UPDATE: Čeferin ruled himself out of running for FIFA president, telling The Rest Is Politics podcast 'my credibility is much, much, much higher if I'm not interested in the position.' He predicted Infantino will either 'recognize his lack of support and step down' or 'have a candidate against him' in March 2027, naming AFC president Sheikh Salman and CONCACAF's Victor Montagliani as possible challengers.]

name: Kevin Lamour
role: Former FIFA Chief Operating Officer (Fired Aug 17, 2026)
quote: It is the project of one person. Not only must this project not go ahead... [Late July 2026, to the Associated Press, on Infantino's World Cup stake-sale plan] If that means I lose my job, then so be it. I will understand and respect that decision. At least I'll sleep well tonight. [Aug 17, 2026 — FIFA fired Lamour, who had joined as COO in November 2024 after nearly two decades as UEFA's deputy general secretary, following his public criticism of Infantino's handling of the abandoned stake-sale plan. His dismissal deepened the leadership crisis and drew fresh criticism from federations already opposed to Infantino's re-election.]

name: Lise Klaveness
quote: There is no trust in Infantino now. The trust is now gone for us, there is no way back for Infantino. [Aug 7, 2026] Klaveness said the FIFA president 'does not have the institutional trust required to govern FIFA stably in the times we are in' and called on him to resign over the abandoned World Cup stake-sale plan.

name: Giovanni Malagò
quote: We will continue to work alongside UEFA and the other European federations to promote a vision of football based on merit, solidarity, sustainability and the central role of fans. [Aug 26, 2026 — announcing the FIGC's withdrawal of support for Gianni Infantino's FIFA re-election bid, citing 'the recent initiatives promoted by the FIFA president concerning governance and the development of international competitions.'] A model based on dialogue, listening and shared responsibility, which has so far allowed football to grow and innovate while at the same time safeguarding its fundamental principles.
